name: Waktunya Kerja!
storyline: You control as Bino, a young man working in many part time jobs off home town for his family. In this life (work) simulation game, you can help him set his weekly work schedule, work hard in his jobs with minigames, and wander around the city to find many stuffs; something you can buy, somewhere relaxing, or some others that took Bino's interest. At the start, he has 3 part time jobs. But, as time passes, he can get more part time jobs with the total of 6 combined. With the deadline of his monthly apartment payment and the deadline of other urgency, will he be able to survive living in the city?
summary: A life (work) simulation game made in RPG Maker 2003 (+ Maniac's Patch). Based on a game made for RaiPGMaker 2025 gamejam, and proudly made by surabayans(??) with a help from friends at Manusia Pagi.
